import numpy as np

def softmax(x):
    e_x = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    return e_x / np.sum(e_x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)

def fine_tune(model, train_data, labels, class_head,
              num_classes, epochs, learning_rate):
    loss_history = []
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        epoch_loss = 0.0
        for input_ids, label in zip(train_data, labels):
            embeddings = model(input_ids)
            cls = embeddings[0]
            logits = np.matmul(cls, class_head)
            probs = softmax(logits)
            one_hot = np.zeros(num_classes)
            one_hot[label] = 1.0
            loss = -np.sum(one_hot * np.log(probs + 1e-9))
            epoch_loss += loss
            gradient = np.outer(cls, (probs - one_hot))
            class_head -= learning_rate * gradient
        avg_loss = epoch_loss / len(train_data)
        loss_history.append(avg_loss)
    return {"class_head": class_head, "loss_history": loss_history}
